sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: An elven knight and right-hand man of the elven queen. Elshif believed the elves to be a superior and noble race, while he considered the shapeshifting tribe that lived in the forest to be a savage and sullied one. One day, he was approached by a human from a certain organization who told him that the shapeshifters were preparing to wipe out the elves. Elshif then proposed to the elven queen to decimate the tribe immediately to ensure her safety, but she refused. However, it wouldn’t be long before their sanctuary and the guards protecting it were attacked by one of the members of the shapeshifting tribe.
